question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Berserk
solution:
The correct answer is** option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Berserk"** means out of control with anger or excitement; wild or frenzied. (उन्मत्त)

 
 
• **Example: **He went berserk when he found out someone had stolen his car.
 
 
 
• **"Demented" **refers to someone who is driven to behave irrationally due to anger, distress, or excitement. (पागल)
 
 
• **Example: **In his demented state, he couldn't make any rational decisions.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Berserk'** is **'Demented'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**., **Demented**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Absurd** (बेतुका): Wildly unreasonable, illogical, or inappropriate.

 
 
• **Example:** The idea of flying pigs is completely absurd.
 
 
 
• **Stubborn** (ज़िद्दी): Having or showing dogged determination not to change one's attitude or position on something.
 
 
• **Example: **He was too stubborn to admit that he was wrong.
 
 
 
• **Lazy** (आलसी): Unwilling to work or use energy.
 
 
• **Example:** She was too lazy to get out of bed.
